summary: Corrected the second stale condition left by the drift-then-snapshot receipt. The behaviour that records the snapshot path's bound still said that no snapshot had been called after a drift, while that receipt is exactly such a call; the statement is restated in the same terms with the receiver-relative phrasing made explicit (the bound is the decided index of the node that receives the call, an index equal to it is mapped to the decided log without the StopSign, a lower index is used as given and a greater one refused), and the conditions now record the executed instance — the leader's decided index was 9 against six indices of content, a request at 8 was accepted, and the bound and range behaved as derived — with the receipt's event indices (e70b8baa087246c78ea3a64f24b8e97c, indices 0-5). This mirrors the trim-bound correction from the previous turn, so both compaction behaviours the parent account relies on now show their executed basis rather than only the source reading. No execution was requested this turn; incomplete are the parent drift's bound/repair probe after many more rounds and leader changes, the trim child's storage-side route probe, the snapshot child's peer and follower sampling, timers and loss triggers, larger clusters, persistence, and any further independent lead.
